name: Plausible Analytics
description: Plausible Analytics is a privacy-focused alternative to Google Analytics that provides website traffic insights without cookies, persistent identifiers, or cross-site tracking, keeping data on European-owned infrastructure.
best_for: Ecommerce, SaaS, digital agencies, content creators, and enterprises wanting cookieless, GDPR-friendly analytics without cookie banners, including white-label options.
features: Automatic scroll-depth tracking across all pages without setup
AI-tool traffic monitoring to identify visits from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and similar services
SEO performance analysis via Search Console integration
UTM campaign tracking with automatic channel grouping
Codeless goal creation for conversions, downloads, and form submissions

alternatives.name: Google Analytics
alternatives.description: A free analytics tool from Google measuring customer behavior across websites and apps.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses of every size wanting free, easy measurement unified with Google's ad platforms.

alternatives.name: Fathom Analytics
alternatives.description: A privacy-focused, cookieless web analytics platform emphasizing simplicity and speed.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious businesses wanting a lightweight, fast-loading analytics script.

alternatives.name: Matomo
alternatives.description: Privacy-first analytics with full data ownership via self-hosted or cloud deployment.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting privacy-compliant analytics without vendor lock-in.

pricing.starting_price: Starter: $9/month at the 10K monthly pageview tier

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Starting price at up to 10K monthly pageviews; one site.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Starting price at up to 10K monthly pageviews; up to 3 sites and 3 team members.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Starting price at up to 10K monthly pageviews; up to 10 sites and 10 team members plus advanced analytics features.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing and limits; contact sales.

cons: Plausible Cloud has no permanent free plan; after the 30-day trial, a paid subscription is required to keep using the hosted service.
Pricing scales with total pageviews plus custom events, and sustained usage above the selected tier can require an upgrade.
